     /// Returns the rotation angle (in degrees) for the arrow so that it visually points
     /// from the arrow's position towards the (rotated) device point. The base arrow asset
     /// points up, therefore a +90° adjustment is applied.
     private func calculateRotationAngle(from arrowPosition: CGPoint, to devicePoint: CGPoint) -> Double {
         let dx = devicePoint.x - arrowPosition.x
         let dy = devicePoint.y - arrowPosition.y
         let angle = atan2(dy, dx) * 180 / .pi
         return angle + 90 // Adjust for arrow pointing up by default
     }

+    /// and avoids transient visibility toggles while the map rotates.
+    private func isCoordinateOutsideRegion(_ coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D,
+                                           in region: MKCoordinateRegion) -> Bool {
+        let eps: CLLocationDegrees = 1e-9
+        let halfLat = max(region.span.latitudeDelta * 0.5, eps)
+        let halfLon = max(region.span.longitudeDelta * 0.5, eps)
+
+        let dLat = coordinate.latitude - region.center.latitude
+        let dLon = deltaLongitude(coordinate.longitude, region.center.longitude)
+
+        let outsideLat = abs(dLat) > halfLat
+        let outsideLon = abs(dLon) > halfLon
+        return outsideLat || outsideLon
+    }
